permissions.setExamAccess: Set who can take a test

accounts.title: Permissions
accounts.description: Assign roles to each account. An account can have several roles, and it can use everything those roles allow. You can't remove your own admin role.

reviewLog.title: Review log
reviewLog.description: Every submitted review is logged. Entries stay even if the decision is changed or the set is deleted. Months follow Taiwan time.
reviewLog.teachersHint: A set reviewed more than once (decision changed) counts as one. Approved or rejected follows the latest decision.

uploadSet.title: Upload sets
uploadSet.description: Sets the AI has concerns about can be uploaded too. A teacher will review them.
uploadSet.pickHint: Choose Question.Generator's results/out, or the folder of a single set. Each set needs set.json and audio.mp3.
uploadSet.uploadN: Upload {count, plural, one {# set} other {# sets}}
uploadSet.done: {count, plural, one {# set} other {# sets}} done. Go to the set list →
uploadSet.picked: {count, plural, one {# set} other {# sets}} selected

outcome.created: Uploaded. Waiting for a teacher's review. {verdict}
outcome.supplemented: Transcript and provenance added. Review status and availability unchanged.
outcome.replaced: Overwritten and sent back for review. It will be listed again once a teacher approves it.
outcome.unchanged: Same as the one on the site. Nothing changed.

existing.supplement: This set is already on the site, with the same questions, answers and audio. Overwriting only adds the transcript and provenance; the review status stays the same.
existing.content: This set is already on the site, and the content is different ({fields}). Overwriting sends it back for review, and it will only be listed again once a teacher approves it. The current review comments are cleared; the review log is kept.
existing.unchanged: This set is already on the site and is exactly the same. No need to upload.

uploadSet.overwriteContent: Overwrite and send back for review
uploadSet.overwriteAllSupplement: Add all transcripts ({count, plural, one {# set} other {# sets}})
uploadSet.retryFailed: Upload {count, plural, one {the failed set} other {# failed sets}} again

examList.title: IELTS Listening Section 1
examList.guestHint: You're seeing the public tests. <login>Log in</login> to take more.
examList.empty: There are no tests to take right now.

exam.unavailableGuest: This test can't be taken right now. <login>Log in</login> and you may be able to take it.
exam.intro: "{title}". When you press start, the recording plays right away. It plays only once and can't be paused or rewound, just like the real exam. The recording includes time to read the questions and time to check at the end. Your answers are submitted automatically when it ends.
exam.statusListen: Recording playing. Fill in the answers as you listen.

errors.unavailable: This test can't be taken right now.
errors.submitFailed: Couldn't submit: {message}. Your answers are still here. Please press "Submit" again.
errors.audioFailed: The recording failed to play. You can keep answering and submit yourself.
errors.audioInterrupted: The recording was interrupted. Please refresh the page and try again.
errors.autoplayBlocked: The recording couldn't start automatically. Please refresh the page and try again.

result.title: Results
result.notFound: We couldn't find the results for this attempt.
result.signupTitle: Want to see the answers? Sign up for free
result.signupBody: Enter your email, then the login code we send you, and you're signed up. This attempt is saved to your account and you'll see the answer to every question.

landing.metaTitle: Practicing More: IELTS Listening practice tests

hero.lead: Modeled on the real exam: reading time and the same pacing. Instant feedback shows you the mistakes you make most.
hero.cta: Try a full test for free

features.title: Why practice here
features.lead: There's no shortcut to listening. Listen more, write more, make more mistakes.

unlimited.title: Always new questions
unlimited.body: New questions every day, new sets every week.

realPace.title: Real exam pacing
realPace.body: Reading pauses, recording pace and a final check, all following the exam timeline.

instantGrading.title: Marked as soon as you submit
instantGrading.body: Capital letters and date formats are checked by the rules. See right away which answers were right or wrong.

weakTraps.title: See your common mistakes
weakTraps.body: Self-corrections, similar numbers, spelling… see where you're weakest.

open.title: Open a test
open.body: No sign-up. Press start and the test begins.

listen.title: Fill in the answer sheet as you listen
listen.body: The page tells you when it's reading time and highlights the blanks to look at.

review.title: See your score and the answers
review.body: Log in with your email to see every answer and keep your practice history.

demo.title: Try a question first
demo.lead: Two questions cut from a real test set. The recording plays only once. Fill in the answers as you listen.
demo.idle: Press play to start (plays only once)
demo.playing: Playing. Fill in the answers as you listen.
demo.ended: The recording has ended. Check your answers.
demo.playFailed: The recording couldn't play. Please refresh the page and try again.

price.a: Trying a test is free and needs no sign-up. Sign up to take more tests and see the answers.

author.a: They're generated in the IELTS Section 1 format, and a teacher reviews each set before it's opened for practice.

score.q: Does my score here reflect my IELTS score?
score.a: No. This is practice, and it has nothing to do with how the real exam is scored.

footer.disclaimer: This site isn't affiliated with IELTS. Practice scores don't represent official scores.
